analyze.q: What does the AI diagnosis analyze?
analyze.a: It analyzes the core indicators of hive health, including disease signs, pests (mites, moths, etc.), and queen bee condition.

accuracy.q: How accurate are the diagnosis results?
accuracy.a: It delivers high accuracy through continuous learning from field data, and we recommend using the results as a reference guide.

offline.a: You can take photos offline, and the analysis results sync once you have a network connection.

free.q: Can I use it for free?
free.a: It is free during the beta period. The official pricing plans will be announced later.

privacy.q: Is my personal information and photo data safe?
privacy.a: All data is encrypted and stored securely, and is never shared with third parties without your consent.
